Saturday Bridge Ride (Blue Ridge Cyclery / BikeFitRVA Racing)

Richmond, VA · Libbie Mill · Road

Saturday Bridge Ride (Blue Ridge Cyclery / BikeFitRVA Racing) is a road group ride in Richmond, VA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from Blue Ridge Cyclery Richmond. Pace: 16–19 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday Bridge Ride (Blue Ridge Cyclery / BikeFitRVA Racing) group ride

An intermediate road ride to Ashland and back for anyone who can hold about 16 mph on their own. It follows the same route as the shop's A+ race-pace ride, so you can start fast and drop back if you need to. Coffee stop at Classic Coffee, Tea and Books in Ashland. Helmet required.
